notes.summary: One live handwritten argument occupies the upper page; an inverted, heavily cancelled draft fills the bottom strip. The complete reading includes raised text, local deletions, overwritten folios and drawn marks.
notes.math_reading_decisions: Comparison of the two order signs and of the application terminal strokes prompted local inspection. Curvature and terminal uprights, not the expected mathematics, decided those forms. The i/I and x/X distinctions were read from size, dots and placement. No theorem or implication was proved or corrected.
notes.author_checks: No mathematical validation performed; check_events is empty. The apparent loss of de under a cancellation stroke and the unclosed quotation are preserved rather than repaired. marked_in_h means H explicitly flags doubt, unreadability or an editorial issue; ordinary insertion/deletion markup alone is not treated as a doubt flag.
notes.title_dates_pagination: No title or date. Top folio remains 70/79 over 69/79 from this page alone. The inverted surface folio is 55 with an uncertain older second digit 4/3. No adjacent folios were consulted.
